title: P0c v2: scorecard efficiency metrics (supersedes T-0451; adds read-time attribution for legacy rows) — tokens and cost per accepted task and goal with fix-round lineage collapsed, tokens and time to first green, time to accepted, first-pass and fix-round rates, fix-round tokens, calls and turns, model distribution, pipeline amplification with the nine-bucket breakdown, grouping by goal, executor, band, class and role, unknown bucket; CLI scorecard --efficiency
spec:
Phase I P0 (brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md, section P0 metrics and amplification). Replaces T-0451 unchanged except item 0. Base goal/T-0445 after P0a (T-0449 merged: row fields bucket, lineage_root, round_index, band, task_class, executor, model, normalized tokens, usd, usd_source; Jev rows with task and bucket; orchestrator/attribution.py with bucket_of, lineage, band, task_class, model_of) and P0b (T-0450: created_at, pipeline.first_green_at, gate_attempts, gate_reds, lineage_fix_rounds, accepted_at) merge. Scout facts: scorecard.build is per executor from execute rows (scorecard.py:186-249); by_task (403), by_goal (471), tokens_per_accepted_goal (637) and usd_per_accepted_goal (654) exist from G1b and H1; _tokens_of (381) keeps the discounted cache-read convention and _legacy_total_only (395) handles pre-normalisation rows; Jev rows are read by jev_footer (359) from runs/jev; the H1 rule: a ratio with zero denominator is None and renders n/a. CLI wiring for scorecard lives in cli.py (136, 237).
0. Legacy rows (every row on disk written before P0a, and any row lacking bucket): a single helper scorecard._attributed(row, tasks) returns the row with bucket, lineage_root, round_index, band, task_class, executor and model filled at read time through orchestrator.attribution from the task file when the row names a task (row.task), and bucket_of(row.role, None) otherwise; rows that already carry the fields are returned unchanged; rows with neither task nor role fall into the unknown group. Every function below reads rows only through _attributed, so history and new rows use one code path. Stamps missing on old tasks (created_at, first_green_at, accepted_at, lineage_fix_rounds) give None for the dependent metric; fix_rounds for old tasks falls back to counting descendants whose constraints.fix_round_for chain reaches the root. Test: test_efficiency_legacy_rows_attributed_at_read_time (a fixture row without bucket, whose task is a fix round, lands in bucket fix_round under its root).
1. scorecard.efficiency(root=STATE, by=None) -> dict. Rows = runs/*.jsonl plus runs/jev/*.jsonl (bucket jev). Attribute every row to a task lineage root (row.lineage_root, else row.task, else unknown) and to a goal (row.goal_id, else the task's parent, else unknown). An accepted task is an execute lineage root whose task has merged_into set (its accepted_at when present). An accepted goal is one whose GOAL task has a pr_url or result with pr_url (reuse accepted_goals(), scorecard.py:621).
Per accepted task: tokens (sum of total_tokens using _tokens_of over every row attributed to the lineage: execute, fix_round, spec_review, review, challenge rows whose task or inputs[0] is in the lineage, jev rows keyed by lineage tasks), cost (usd sum), tokens_to_first_green (rows with ts <= root first_green_at), time_to_first_green_s (first_green_at - created_at), time_to_accepted_s (accepted_at - created_at), calls (row count), turns (sum turns), fix_rounds, fix_round_tokens (bucket fix_round rows), first_pass (first_green_at present and fix_rounds == 0 and gate_reds == 0; None when stamps are missing). Missing stamps make the specific metric None, never a crash.
Per accepted goal: the sums over its accepted tasks plus planner rows (bucket planner with goal_id) and scout rows for that goal, with tokens_per_accepted_goal and usd_per_accepted_goal kept consistent with the existing functions (test that the new goal total equals tokens_per_accepted_goal for a fixture).
Rates over accepted tasks: first_pass_rate and fix_round_rate (share with fix_rounds >= 1) over tasks where the value is defined, with the defined count reported, avg_fix_rounds, median and max tokens per accepted task, model_distribution (rows and tokens per model per bucket).
Amplification: breakdown = tokens per bucket in the fixed order Planner, Scout, Execution (bucket execute, initial runs only), Fix rounds, Spec review, Code review, Challenge, Jev, Other (bucket other or memory or unattributed) plus Total; pipeline_amplification = Total / Execution, None when Execution is 0. Computed for the whole window and per group.
by in {None, goal, executor, band, class, role}: groups accepted tasks (role groups rows instead) and reports the per-group rates, medians, breakdown and amplification. An unknown group collects rows without a task or goal and is always shown with its token total so nothing silently disappears.
2. CLI: orchestrator scorecard --efficiency [--by goal|executor|band|class|role] [--json] renders a text table with n/a for None and a footer with the breakdown and amplification; --json dumps the dict. Existing scorecard flags unchanged.
3. Docstrings in scorecard.py name each formula; README is P0d's job.
Tests (tests/test_scorecard.py with synthetic runs and tasks fixtures, tests/test_cli.py for the CLI): test_efficiency_legacy_rows_attributed_at_read_time, test_efficiency_collapses_fix_round_lineage_into_root, test_efficiency_first_pass_and_fix_round_rates, test_efficiency_tokens_and_time_to_first_green_use_stamps, test_efficiency_missing_stamps_give_none_not_crash, test_efficiency_amplification_breakdown_sums_to_total_and_none_at_zero_execution, test_efficiency_unknown_bucket_is_reported, test_efficiency_goal_total_matches_tokens_per_accepted_goal, test_efficiency_group_by_band_class_executor_role, test_efficiency_model_distribution, test_cli_scorecard_efficiency_text_and_json. Existing scorecard and cli tests stay green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A; commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: scorecard.efficiency returns every metric in the brief's P0 list with None for undefined values and an unknown bucket; legacy rows without attribution fields are attributed at read time; the breakdown order is Planner, Scout, Execution, Fix rounds, Spec review, Code review, Challenge, Jev, Other, Total, Amplification
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
